Dawn and I lit Government House blue and green to honor organ donors who have given the gift of life to others.

Thank you to them, our hospitals, health care workers, community partners, and everyone who chose to be a donor.

Learn more about saving lives at donatelifemaryland.org
Maryland is home to tens of thousands of Arab Americans, and we’re proud to celebrate the ways they’ve shaped Maryland into a stronger and more prosperous place.

Dawn and I are heartbroken by Earle “Jock” Freedman’s passing.

He was our state’s longest-service public servant. Someone who dedicated over six decades of his life to @MDSHA, designing and safeguarding thousands of bridges that Marylanders rely on to this day – including the Naval Academy Bridge.

Jock, thank you for everything. We're a safer and stronger state because of your devotion to us all.

Welcome home to the four brave astronauts of Artemis II! 🚀

Congrats on the historic journey. We’re all so proud of what you’ve accomplished and happy you got home safe and sound.


NASA (@NASA)

Welcome home Reid, Victor, Christina, and Jeremy! 🫶

The Artemis II astronauts have splashed down at 8:07pm ET (0007 UTC April 11), bringing their historic 10-day mission around the Moon to an end.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/NASA/status/2042756933686337713#m

Right now, we have state-owned land near Metro stations, but that land is underdeveloped. It’s not generating tax revenue. It’s not creating jobs. It’s not lowering housing costs.

So, @LtGovMiller and I are changing that. 

We're going to build housing on that land and turn it into assets that will help bring in nearly $1.4 billion in state and local tax revenue from developing state-owned land alone.

Video

Marylanders should not be asked to subsidize the soaring energy demands of large new data centers.

As we work to build an affordable and reliable energy future, we need rules that protect families and businesses, strengthen the grid, and ensure that the biggest new contributors to growth pay their fair share.

By working in partnership with our law enforcement officials, we're delivering historic results for Maryland – including Wicomico County’s largest cocaine seizure.

This work to keep our communities safe matters, and I’ll continue working with our law enforcement partners to give them the support they need to continue holding violent criminals accountable.

Video

We’re delivering for Marylanders, without raising taxes and without raising fees.

Video

We did something seemingly impossible in Washington and passed our fourth balanced budget.

We invested in public safety, in education, and in making life more affordable for our people – and we did it without raising taxes or fees on our people.

🔴 LIVE: Signing the FY2027 Budget

This budget makes smart investments to:

✅ Keep our communities safe,
✅ Lower costs for families, and
✅ Strengthen our economic competitiveness.

All without raising taxes or fees. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1qKDzPOZW…

I will not tolerate people who target our communities and hurt our loved ones and think they will not be held accountable. Not in Maryland.

Thirteen different agencies came together and busted a drug-trafficking organization affiliated with a cartel that trafficked narcotics across the region. Thank you to everyone and every agency who played a part in the largest cocaine seizure in the history of Wicomico County.

These arrests keep our streets safe from those who have been terrorizing our com

Marylanders, tax season’s almost over!

We’ve expanded credits and benefits to put money back into the pockets of Maryland families, so be sure to check your eligibility for these state and federal benefits when you file your taxes:

💰 Maryland Earned Income Tax Credit: Marylanders could get up to $4,000 back on their state tax return.

🧑‍🧒 Maryland Child Tax Credit: Eligible families with children can receive a $500 credit per child to help with the cost of raising children.

🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Section 530A

Across the Baltimore region, there are over 130 acres of state-owned land ready for development, ready to support nearly 5,000 new homes, and ready to generate almost $1.4 billion in state and local tax revenue. 

Together with @MayorBMScott, our General Assembly partners, and @MarylandDOT, we’re going to deliver safer, reliable, cheaper transit options and build housing connected to transit, community, and opportunity.

For far too long, some communities have been asked to accept being underestimated and undervalued.

We’ve rejected that. At Edmondson Village, we're helping to deliver health care, fresh food, support for seniors, and new investments in child care so that we can together rewrite a narrative about a city and a community that have been historically ignored.

From Day One, our administration chose to invest in the people of Baltimore – because for this to be Maryland’s decade, it must be Baltimore’
Spring has sprung here in Annapolis! 💐

As families, friends, and communities in Maryland and around the world gather today to celebrate Easter, our hearts are with all who are facing uncertainty, fear, and hardship.

May today's celebrations renew spirits, breathe new hope into the world, and bring much-needed peace to all in Maryland and beyond. 🕊️

After continuous community pushback, court orders, and united work from elected officials, we’re seeing ICE backtrack on this detention warehouse near Hagerstown.

When we contacted DHS in February, we relayed our concerns about this process – including the lack of transparency, federal-local collaboration, or public input from the local community.
